Title: 500826-2026: Italy – Architectural, engineering and surveying services – Open procedure for the award of engineering and architecture services relating to the P.E, CSP, CSE and D.L. for the following project: Development and Cohesion Fund 2021-2027. Completion works for the new construction of a building to strengthen the school complex of the I.I.S.S. Bachelet and the Liceo Don T. Bello Copertino.
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: New building to supplement a school campus (campus projects are of interest for sbp); the project is located in Italy and there are no indications of special size or complex structural engineering tasks, therefore only medium priority.
titel: Open procedure for engineering and architectural services for the completion of a school building to expand the school campus of the I.I.S.S. Bachelet and the Liceo Don Tonino Bello in Copertino
kurzbeschreibung: Planning and site supervision services for the completion of a school extension building in Copertino.
umfang: Completion of a new building to expand a school campus for the I.I.S.S. Bachelet and the Liceo Don Tonino Bello. Specific technical parameters such as GFA, spans, number of storeys or structural system are not stated in the notice.
leistungen: Execution planning, health and safety coordination in the planning phase, health and safety coordination in the execution phase, site supervision.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Building construction project for public education facilities and therefore of general relevance.
• It concerns engineering and architectural services with planning and site supervision components, i.e. not a pure construction contract.
• The notice does not contain any information on the structural concept, spans, architectural special features or structural complexity.
• School buildings are not among the particularly high-priority sbp target projects such as bridges, stadiums, long-span roofs or special structures.
• Location Italy is in principle feasible, but without particular strategic priority from the watchlist or regional guidance.
• The fee volume is solid, but without identifiable structural particularities only medium to low priority.
baukosten_erklaerung: The notice only states the estimated contract value for the planning services of 880988,06 EUR and the tender amount of 734156,72 EUR. There is no information on chargeable costs, construction costs, GFA, volume, structure or fee parameters. A reliable estimate of construction costs for cost groups 300/400 is therefore not possible; for a school extension building, a multi-million construction volume would be roughly conceivable, but this would be speculative here.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Eligibility criteria according to the contract documents; not specified in detail in the notice itself.
auftraggeber: Provincia di Lecce, Via Umberto I, 13, 73100 Lecce, Italy, E-Mail: appaltiecontratti@cert.provincia.le.it, Telefon: +39 08326831, Website: http://www.provincia.le.it
notes: Estimated contract value excluding VAT: 880988,06 EUR. Tender amount: 734156,72 EUR including incidental costs and surcharges, excluding social security contributions, pension contributions and VAT. Duration: 40 days. Submission of tenders electronically via https://provincialecce.tuttogare.it. Procedure language: Italian.
